grain_rationale: The profile reports row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning there are no exact duplicate rows at the full-row level; each row represents one scheduled flight segment (an event), so grain_type is transaction. No single column is unique on its own (flight_number has only 2994 distinct values against 166158 rows, so distinct_count does not equal row_count), so the identity is derived from the ordered tuple (flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, sched_dep_hhmm), which together identify a unique scheduled departure and absorbs any collision that flight_number alone would produce; since duplicate_row_rate is already 0.0, this identity tuple cannot be less granular than the raw rows.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct days with zero nulls; used as part of the flight identity rather than the event timestamp.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter carrier code (e.g. 9E, AA, DL) with 16 distinct values and zero nulls, identifying the operating carrier.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number ranging 1-8500 across 2994 distinct values; it labels the flight rather than measuring a quantity, so it is a dimension despite being numeric.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Three-letter NYC origin airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA), zero nulls, consistent with the origin join's declared completeness.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as an HHMM integer (500-2359, 969 distinct values); it labels a scheduled clock time rather than a summable quantity.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Three-letter destination airport code with 100 distinct values and zero nulls.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft registration tail number with 3825 distinct values; 1521 rows (0.92% null_rate) are null, consistent with occasional missing registry linkage.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Boolean flag with values false/true indicating whether the flight was cancelled; zero nulls.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time as an HHMM integer; 4883 rows (2.94% null_rate) are null, matching flights that never departed and therefore keep no actual time per the operator context.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes, negative when early (sample min -33, max 1301); nulls (2.94% null_rate) align with flights lacking an actual departure.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time as an HHMM integer; 5101 rows (3.07% null_rate) null for flights with no recorded arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time as an HHMM integer (1-2359), zero nulls.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes, negative when early (sample min -86, max 1272); 5480 rows (3.3% null_rate) null for flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Flight air time in minutes (20-695 sampled); 5480 rows (3.3% null_rate) null, matching flights without completed arrival data.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance between origin and destination in miles (80-4983 sampled), summable and comparable across flights, zero nulls.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure hour in local time (5-23, 19 distinct values), a derived label of sched_dep_hhmm rather than a measure; zero nulls.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure minute in local time (0-59), labeling the scheduled clock time; zero nulls.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Scheduled departure converted to UTC and truncated to the hour (all sampled values land on :00:00, 3439 distinct hours spanning 2013-01-01T10:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00); this is the event timestamp and resolves only to hour grain.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier name (e.g. Delta Air Lines Inc., Southwest Airlines Co.) from the carrier lookup join, which the operator context notes is complete; 16 distinct values, zero nulls.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer from the registry join (e.g. BOEING, AIRBUS); 26656 rows (16.04% null_rate) null, reflecting the aircraft join's completeness floor noted in context.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model from the registry join; 26656 rows (16.04% null_rate) null, matching the aircraft join's gaps.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Aircraft manufacture year (1956-2013 sampled), a labeling attribute rather than a measure; 29332 rows (17.65% null_rate) null from registry join gaps.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Aircraft seat capacity (2-450 sampled), a summable and comparable quantity; 26656 rows (16.04% null_rate) null, matching the aircraft join's completeness floor.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type (e.g. Turbo-fan, Reciprocating) with 6 distinct values; 26656 rows (16.04% null_rate) null, matching the aircraft registry join gaps.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name (3 distinct values covering JFK, LGA, EWR), zero nulls given the origin join's declared completeness.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin municipality (New York or Newark), zero nulls.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21), an airport attribute label rather than a flight measure; zero nulls.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511), an airport attribute label; zero nulls.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name; 3471 rows (2.09% null_rate) null, matching the destination join's completeness floor noted in context.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination municipality; 3471 rows (2.09% null_rate) null, matching destination join gaps.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: Destination ISO region code (e.g. US-CA, PR-U-A); 3471 rows (2.09% null_rate) null from the same destination join gaps.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet (3-6606 sampled); 3471 rows (2.09% null_rate) null, matching destination join gaps.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet (5076-16000 sampled); 3471 rows (2.09% null_rate) null, matching destination join gaps.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp recorded by the pipeline (16 distinct second-level values around 2026-09-02T23:25-23:26), not the business event time, so mapped as a dimension rather than the time field.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight segment departing from a NYC-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) in 2013, carrying its scheduled and actual departure/arrival times, delay and air-time measures, carrier identity, and joined aircraft and airport attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, assigning the departure_hour_utc timestamp as the event time, declaring a derived transaction-grain identity over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and sched_dep_hhmm, and classifying every silver column's role for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models; it is consumed by that engine, not executed here.
usage: The modeling engine reads this mapping to render the gold flights fact and its associated dimensions; the proposal is first rendered to an ODCS mapping contract, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval.
limitations: This mapping does not resolve the partial join completeness noted in the operator context: aircraft attributes are null on 16.04% of rows and destination attributes are null on 2.09% of rows, and consumers must decide how to treat flights with missing actual departure or arrival times (2.94%-3.3% null_rate), such as cancelled or diverted flights; no filtering, deduplication beyond the declared identity tuple, or derived transformation is proposed here.
